title: The Castle Key
subtitle: Barnwell Walk
welcome_text: [[c:A mystery walk along Barnwell Brook, past a 13th-century castle, two churches and a set of 1601 almshouses.]]
start_text: [[c:Start at the Montagu Arms on Main Street.]]

coins.explain: [[c:You have a purse of 5 coins for the whole walk. Hints are free. Showing an answer costs coins.]]

layers.label: Mystery story
layers.description: [[c:The story and the puzzles. Switch it off for a history-only walk.]]

story: [[c:Barnwell, 1601. Parson Nicholas Latham has just founded almshouses for the poor of the village, and the money for them is kept in a chest in the old castle.]]
[[c:This morning the great iron key to the chest has vanished, and with it the parson's plans.]]

[[c:Four people had a chance to take it: Hal Freeman, the castle keeper; Bess Carter, who keeps house for the parson; Robin Stokes, the miller's son; and Master Giles Thorne, a lawyer from London. Find the key.]]

start_page.title: Getting to the start
start_page.intro: [[c:The walk starts and finishes at the Montagu Arms.]]
parking: [[c:Parking: please park considerately on the village streets, or ask at the pub. If you're driving, park first and then open the walk.]]
start_page.support: [[c:Support the village: have a drink at the Montagu Arms before or after your walk. The walk takes about 1 hour to 1 hour 30.]]

medium:7-8: [[c:Walk back south along the brook, past the Montagu Arms, and keep going south down the village street for about 900 metres to All Saints.]]
short:7-9: [[c:Walk back south along Armston Road beside the brook to the Montagu Arms, about 310 metres.]]

lengths_note: Route colours: short green, medium copper, long blue. legs = path along real roads/paths between consecutive stops (from OpenStreetMap).
